name: University of Glasgow

facts.text: The University of Glasgow was founded in 1451 and is celebrating its 575th anniversary.
Glasgow is a world top 100 university and a member of the Russell Group of leading UK research universities.
Glasgow is ranked in the top 30 universities in the world for sustainability.
Campus landmarks include the Hunterian Museum, the University Library and the James McCune Smith Learning Hub.
Once you are unconditional and have accepted your offer, Glasgow says you should receive your CAS within 5-10 working days; a CAS must be issued no more than 6 months before your visa application.

sources.notes: Describes the UKVI credibility interview only: conducted 'by a UKVI officer', 'By video call', 'By telephone' or 'In person at a Visa Application Centre'. 'Not all students will be asked to attend an interview, and UKVI does not publish details of how applicants are selected.' 'There are no correct answers.' 'Your visa application may be refused if UKVI is not satisfied that you are a genuine student.' Tips: answer honestly, speak clearly, ask for repetition, give detailed answers, avoid memorised answers. No university-run pre-CAS interview, CAS Shield or Enroly mentioned anywhere seen.

sources.title: Your CAS - Postgraduate - Applicant approval guide | University of Glasgow
